column3: Close to the Hebrew; “conduct a case with the mountains” is rendered “plead your case before the mountains.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the case” is rendered “complaint,” and “enduring ones” “strong.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a house of slaves” is rendered “the house of bondage.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Shittim” is rendered “Acacia Grove,” and “the righteous acts” “the righteousness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the God of height” is rendered “the High God.”
Close to the Hebrew; “covenant loyalty” is rendered “mercy,” and “to be modest to walk” “to walk humbly.”
NKJV renders “sound wisdom will see your name” as “Wisdom shall see Your name,” and “hear, O tribe” as “Hear the Rod!”; the meaning of the Hebrew is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; “shall I be clean with” is rendered “Shall I count pure those with.”
Close to the Hebrew; “your emptiness” is rendered “Hunger.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies the verb “make” before “sweet wine.”
